newsitem.title: CANADA: Exall ups Glimmer Mine reserves by 54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Exall ups Glimmer Mine reserves by 54 pct.

text.p: Exall Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that it raised its mineable reserve at the Glimmer Mine in Ontario by 54 percent to 275,100 ounces of gold from 178,900 ounces.
The new estimate is based on diamond drill information updated to March 31.
"We have been able to add signficantly to the original estimate and we expect to continue to build reserves as our exploration programs continue," said Exall President Stephen Roman.
Exall will bring the mine into commercial production as early as July with an annual rate of 65,000 ounces of gold at cash operating costs of $220 per ounce.
Exall owns 65.53 percent and Glimmer Resources Inc holds 34.47 percent.
